name: The Treasure Chest — Spring Blush
story: Closed, it is a keepsake. Opened, it is a spring garden.
description: A small chest of textured handmade paper with a curved trunk lid that lifts to reveal the flowers inside — closed it looks like a keepsake box, open it is a garden. Small enough to hold in two hands, and the lid closes again afterwards, so the box stays on a dressing table long after the flowers have gone. Filled with blush-pink roses, white spray chrysanthemums and clouds of gypsophila. Our most giftable piece, and the one people keep. Hand-arranged fresh in Jaipur. Flowers may vary slightly with market availability; we always keep to the same colours and style.
deliveryInfo: Same-day delivery across Jaipur: order by 2 PM for delivery by 6 PM; later orders arrive by 12 PM. Free delivery across Jaipur. Arrives ready to display — no vase needed.
